title: Scattered Spider member Tyler Buchanan sentenced to six years in US prison
org: US Department of Justice (Central District of California)
summary: Tyler Robert Buchanan, 24, a British member of Scattered Spider, was sentenced to six years in US federal prison. Phishing from September 2021 to April 2023 hit telecom, tech and crypto firms, and stolen credentials enabled SIM swaps that took over $11.6 million in virtual currency. He was arrested in Spain in June 2024 and pleaded guilty in April.
plain: A British hacker from the Scattered Spider group got six years in a US prison for phishing and SIM-swap thefts of over $11.6 million in crypto.
exec: Another Scattered Spider prosecution concludes; the group's phishing and SIM-swap methods remain relevant to help desks and telecoms.
action: No patch needed. Keep help-desk identity checks and SIM-swap protections in place for staff and executives.

key_findings: Six-year sentence; accomplice Noah Urban received 10 years.
Phishing ran Sept 2021 to April 2023; over $11.6 million in virtual currency stolen via SIM swaps.
